commitResults.messageBody: Restore saved task types, details, and completion states when Gooble starts, with regression coverage for persistence.

commitResults.messageTitle: Harden persistence and command edge cases
commitResults.messageBody: Use resilient relative storage handling, validate task data, preserve compatibility with legacy records, and cover first-run and malformed-input scenarios.

commitResults.messageTitle: Change Gooble's understanding of date and time
Add special comment for chinese new year
README: Update saves, date-and-time recognition, special comments and filter by date-and-time

commitResults.messageBody: Move Gooble's welcome banner and divider rendering behind a dedicated Ui class. Keep command processing and task behavior unchanged while establishing the first small OOP extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task list rendering into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Let Ui own the presentation of list output while Gooble continues to select the command behavior. Preserve the existing task ordering and numbering exactly.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task state feedback into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Extract mark, unmark, and delete response messages into Ui while keeping validation and TaskList mutations in Gooble. Preserve existing wording and output order.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task addition feedback into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Extract the shared confirmation and task-count presentation for todo, deadline, and event commands into Ui while preserving deadline greetings and existing output order.
Move command type recognition and argument extraction out of Gooble into Parser, leaving command validation and execution in the main application flow.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task file I/O into Storage
commitResults.messageBody: Move reading, atomic writing, temporary-file cleanup, and storage warnings into Storage. Keep TaskList responsible for task operations and record serialization/parsing while preserving the existing file format.
Add a Storage-aware TaskList constructor while retaining the default data/Gooble.txt constructor. Reject null storage dependencies and keep existing runtime behavior unchanged.
Create the storage dependency at the application entry point and inject it into TaskList, making persistence wiring explicit without changing command behavior.
Keep command input validation with Parser while preserving the existing error message and command behavior in Gooble.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse deadline and event syntax in Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move command-structure validation and field extraction for deadline and event commands into Parser while keeping task creation and date interpretation in Gooble.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse event list ranges in Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move list-from date-time range extraction and validation into Parser while leaving event filtering and display in Gooble.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move remaining simple responses into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Extract the exit message and legacy add confirmation into Ui, keeping Gooble focused on command orchestration and preserving exact console output.
Add Gooble fields, constructor, and run method for Ui, Parser, Storage, and TaskList. Reduce main to composition and startup, following the Duke-style object-oriented structure.

Add CommandContext and CommandHandler abstractions and migrate the basic list command to ListCommand selected by CommandType. Preserve all existing behavior while establishing the extensible dispatch pattern.

commitResults.messageTitle: Migrate task state commands to handlers
commitResults.messageBody: Route mark, unmark, and delete through enum-selected CommandHandler implementations, reusing a shared task-index operation while preserving existing validation and UI output.
Route todo and add through dedicated command handlers selected by CommandType, preserving validation, persistence, and confirmation output.
Add ByeCommand and preserve list-from range handling while using enum-selected dispatch for supported commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Migrate deadline and event commands to handlers
commitResults.messageBody: Add dedicated handlers for deadline creation, event creation, and ranged event listing, and route them through enum-selected dispatch while preserving existing parsing, filtering, greetings, and output.
Create CommandContext alongside Gooble's core dependencies so the run loop reuses the application context instead of wiring services locally.
Replace the redundant CommandHandler interface with an abstract Command class shared by all existing command implementations. Add isExit support to ByeCommand without changing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use Command isExit to control Gooble loop
commitResults.messageBody: Adopt the stretch-goal termination pattern by letting ByeCommand signal exit through the abstract Command API instead of special-casing BYE in Gooble.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse input directly into Command objects
commitResults.messageBody: Give commands their input at construction time, add Parser.parse and UnknownCommand, and simplify Gooble's active run loop to parse, execute, and inspect isExit without command-type branching.
Delete the commented legacy if-else dispatcher, unused banner, and duplicate event filtering from Gooble now that Parser and Command subclasses own command execution.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize Java sources into gooble package
commitResults.messageBody: Move all application classes below the src/main/java source root into the gooble package and add package declarations. Keep the source root unchanged and ignore temporary package compilation output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Split Gooble sources into focused packages
commitResults.messageBody: Organize commands, task models, storage, and UI under gooble.command, gooble.task, gooble.storage, and gooble.ui while retaining src/main/java as the source root.
